name: lockfile-maintenance
instructions:
Maintain the skills lockfile by detecting missing, stale, extra, or mismatched skill entries and updating hashes only after the corresponding SKILL.md files are resolved.

Capabilities:
- apply the lockfile-maintenance workflow

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/skill-dev/lockfile-maintenance/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Lockfile entries match the current skill tree or every drift item has a stated blocker and recommended repair.
